x: He was placed third in a race described as the 440 yards Club Championship. [Incidentally, at the same meeting, Harry Evans won the Mile Walk Handicap, off 10 yards; and Ted Good, present at our last A.G.M., won the Steeplechase Handicap, in which George Still (scratch) was third.

We congratulate Ted Good on recovering from a very serious illness and wish him well for many years yet. Ted was sustained in his battle for life by the fighting spirit he acquired fifty years earlier in the Club teams and, he writes, in his delirious condition he re-fought his team battles over and…

In our last issue we gave news of Ted Good, whose years with the Club extended over half a century. We now learn with sincere regret of his death; it is evident that he never fully recovered from his most serious illness of a few months ago.
